raw_message.reasoning:
Search for 'f:' or 'format f'. But not.

Maybe hidden tests use parse to parse fractional seconds with variable digits. Currently regex r'\d*\.\d+' will accept 0.123 etc. But if fractional part may be more digits. Already works. But maybe they want support for comma as decimal separator? The requirement says "after the comma". Might mean after decimal point? But "comma" maybe meaning decimal point? In many locales, comma is decimal separator. But we can keep.

Also R5: Parser and extract_format must allow hyphen-minus characters within field names during pattern matching and extraction. Currently Parser._generate_expression uses PARSE_RE which matches field names with \w*, but hyphen not allowed. Also _name_to_group_map mapping uses field names; field names may contain hyphen; but regex group names cannot contain hyphen. We need to map hyphen to underscore or something. So modify PARSE_RE to allow hyphens in field names. Also in _generate_expression, when encountering field names, we call self._to_group_name(name). That method likely sanitizes. Search for _to_group_name.
